description: This file defines a benchmark class for testing the TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract benchmark class and overrides a method to instantiate the specific algorithm implementation with a given policy.

classes.name: TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithmBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for testing the TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm within the Eclipse Ditto enforcers testbench. It overrides the method to return a TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm instance given a policy.

methods.name: getPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to instantiate and return a TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm configured with the provided policy.
